Solution 2 gives q = 1 + ln 2 ≈ 1.6931. I recall that a moment threshold of 1 + ln 2 appears in the literature on divisible sandpiles on bounded-degree graphs, but I did not verify the derivation or the source, so my confidence is moderate. Solution 1's constant 1 + Σ 1/(2ⁿ−1) is not supported by its sketched argument. Solution 3 relies on the claim that ℤ explodes for p ≤ 2, which conflicts with the known behavior of ℤ with mean below 1.
